opportunities.title: Digital Customer Service training with a guaranteed interview
opportunities.summary: Six-week hybrid course (Monday to Friday, 8am–4pm) for call-centre, telesales and customer-care roles. Graduates are guaranteed an interview with one of Generation's employer partners within 90 days; the programme page lists a minimum salary of Ksh 15,000 plus commission. Nairobi intake is ongoing.
opportunities.eligibility: Age 22–35. The programme page asks for KCSE mean grade C- with C- in English and also mentions a diploma; confirm the requirement when you apply.

opportunities.title: Digital Marketing (AI-enhanced) training, Westlands
opportunities.summary: Ten-week classroom course at West Point, Westlands (Monday to Friday, 8am–4pm) preparing you for entry-level digital marketing jobs. Graduates are guaranteed an interview with an employer partner within 90 days. Intake is ongoing.
opportunities.eligibility: Age 22–35. KCSE mean grade C- with C- in English.

opportunities.title: Digital Marketing (AI-enhanced) training, Nakuru
opportunities.summary: Ten-week classroom course at Shabab, Nakuru (Monday to Friday, 8am–4pm) preparing you for entry-level digital marketing jobs. Graduates are guaranteed an interview with an employer partner within 90 days. Intake is ongoing.
opportunities.eligibility: Age 22–35. KCSE mean grade C- with C- in English.

opportunities.title: Virtual Assistant course (online, self-paced)
opportunities.summary: Learn the skills used in remote virtual-assistant work: about 10 weeks at 20 hours a week, at your own pace, starting any time. ALX says eligible learners can get sponsored training through a Mastercard Foundation partnership; check the fee shown for Kenya before you enrol.
opportunities.eligibility: No prior experience required. You need a phone or computer and internet access.

opportunities.title: NYOTA youth programme: business capital, apprenticeships and savings
opportunities.organisation: State Department for Youth Affairs (NYOTA Project)
opportunities.summary: Government programme offering capital for youth businesses, apprenticeships with on-the-job experience, certification of skills you already have, and the Haba Haba savings scheme. Applications open in announced windows through USSD *254#; call the toll-free line 0800 222 221 to ask whether a window is open. All NYOTA services are free: anyone asking you to pay is not NYOTA.
opportunities.eligibility: Kenyan citizens aged 18–29 (18–35 for youth with disabilities registered with NCPWD), with a national ID and a SIM card registered in your own name. The 2025 call was for youth whose education did not go beyond Form 4.

opportunities.title: Free digital skills and online work training at Jitume hubs
opportunities.summary: Free training at Jitume hubs in national polytechnics and TVET colleges (over 400 hubs): finding local and international online work, digital literacy, and government e-services such as SHA, KRA and HELB. Walk in to a participating polytechnic near you to register.

opportunities.title: Get a certificate for skills you learned on the job (RPL)
opportunities.summary: Recognition of Prior Learning assesses skills gained through work, including informal jua kali work, and leads to a recognised certificate. You compile evidence (CV, references, work samples), then do a competency conversation or practical observation. It usually takes about six weeks after you submit your evidence. Contact: +254 20 2100272, info@knqa.go.ke.
opportunities.eligibility: Solid experience in your trade. Formal, informal, paid and voluntary work all count.
opportunities.cost_label: Fee depends on the units assessed; quoted before assessment

opportunities.title: Government jobs and internships: get ready on the PSC portal
opportunities.summary: The Public Service Commission advertises national government jobs and internships several times a year (the last round, 851 posts, closed on 13 October 2026). Register and complete your profile now so you can apply quickly when the next advert opens.
opportunities.eligibility: Varies by advert. Most ask for your national ID and academic certificates; many also ask for a Certificate of Good Conduct.
opportunities.cost_label: Free: PSC charges no fees at any stage

opportunities.title: Certificate of Good Conduct (police clearance) for job applications
opportunities.summary: Many employers, internships and the NYS ask for a valid police clearance certificate. Apply in the DCI section of eCitizen, pay online, then have your fingerprints taken at the place you chose, bringing the C24 form and payment receipts. Allow two weeks to a month. Only download it from eCitizen; ignore anyone offering to email it to you.
opportunities.eligibility: Adults: original national ID and copies.

opportunities.title: Ajira Digital online-work training at Makueni CIC centres
opportunities.summary: Training, tools and mentorship for online work, delivered at the county's CIC centres in Wote, Matiliku, Mulala, Tawa, Nunguni, Kasikeu, Kikima and Kalawani. Contact the county to join the next class: 0795 717 885 or info@makueni.go.ke.
opportunities.eligibility: Youth in Makueni County; ask the county about selection.

support_resources.name: Check if a rehab centre is NACADA-accredited
support_resources.description: NACADA publishes the facilities it has accredited for alcohol and drug treatment, with contacts, and lets you filter by county. Check a centre is on the list before you pay or admit someone.

support_resources.name: Alcoholics Anonymous Kenya
support_resources.description: Free peer support groups for anyone who wants to stop drinking. There are no age or education requirements. AA Kenya publishes a list of meetings around the country.

support_resources.name: SAPTA Outpatient Treatment Centre
support_resources.description: Outpatient assessment, counselling and treatment for alcohol and drug use, for adolescents, young adults and adults, with family involvement. Fees follow a published schedule by age and student status. No inpatient beds; refers to approved inpatient programmes. Email frontdesk@sapta.or.ke.
